# Nvisy

> Nvisy is an AI-powered document redaction platform that automatically identifies and removes sensitive information from documents. Enterprise-grade security meets compliance automation.

## Features

- AI-Powered Redaction: Automatically detect and redact PII, PHI, and confidential data from any document
- Multi-Platform Support: Available as Cloud service, On-Premise Server, and Desktop application
- Enterprise Integration: REST APIs, webhooks, and integrations with cloud storage and development tools
- Real-time Processing: Redact documents in seconds with AI precision
- Open Source: Core services and desktop application are open source

## Products

- Cloud: Fully managed SaaS platform with global infrastructure
- Server: Self-hosted on-premise solution for maximum control
- Desktop: Cross-platform desktop application for local document processing
